propositions: Missing or empty JIRA_PAT environment variable silently falls back to anonymous access instead of failing with a named error
Documentation promises that missing JIRA_PAT fails with an error naming the variable, but the implementation reads an empty string and passes it as the bearer token without validation
Anonymous credential results in misleading Jira errors (e.g. 'project does not exist') that misdirect operators away from the actual root cause
PAT validation must occur in build_client_from_settings before network calls to avoid breaking Python 3.11 Protocol conformance checks
Settings resolution must remain total and not raise on missing JIRA_PAT to preserve hasattr compatibility on Python 3.11
